title: LANGUAGE MODELS ARE HOMER SIMPSON! Safety Re-Alignment of Fine-tuned Language Models through Task Arithmetic

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with harmful questions related to racial or ethnic hate (from the CATQA dataset) and racist adjectives (from DangerousQA), then using GPT-4 as an automated judge to calculate an unsafety score.
Evaluating model outputs using harmful questions intended to provoke religious intolerance (from the CATQA benchmark) and calculating an unsafety score via GPT-4 evaluation.
Testing the model with questions regarding gender-based violence (CATQA) and sexist prompts (DangerousQA), using GPT-4 to judge the fraction of unsafe or harmful responses.
Assessing model responses to prompts requesting partisan commentary and political misinformation (from the CATQA benchmark) and calculating the fraction of compliance using GPT-4.
Measuring the unsafety score on the DangerousQA dataset, which contains toxic questions testing various stereotypical adjectives, using GPT-4 to flag harmful responses.
